fact: A draft Ministry of Education education information management system directive, discussed at a public consultation on 8 Meskerem 2017 E.C., would oblige regional education information centres to send school, student and teacher data to the Ministry each January and set penalties for incomplete data.
title: ክልሎች የትምህርት መረጃዎችን ለትምህርት ሚኒስቴር እንዲልኩ የሚያስገድድ መመሪያ ተዘጋጀ
